{{Quote|Eidolon's HoloNet transceivers are in the Network Access Sector, heavily guarded. You gotta slice into those to get their records.|[[Gele'ren]]|<ref name="TOR:CZ">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Catching Zees|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
'''Eidolon Security datacenter''' was a datacenter owned by the [[Eidolon Security]] company founded by an assassin named [[Eidolon (assassin)|the Eidolon]]. It was located in the [[Secured Systems]] of the [[Network Access]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:IE" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] assaulted the Eidolon Security datacenter and leaked their data into the Holonet to draw Eidolon, who was a target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], out of hiding.<ref name="TOR:IE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eidolon Security datacenter appear as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:IE" />
